Name: Catalyst - Introduction I
Event Information: Find out how to drive agency in your school using the tracker
Description:
Welcome, to unlocking the capacity in your school

Throughout 2023, school leaders have been engaging with School Improvement Tracker to help release the experience and knowledge inside their school teams to both improve schools but also to help to engage staff across their organisation.

T﻿his short introduction will outline the SIAT model and our approach to engaging with all staff members in order to create self-improving organsiations.

T﻿he seminar includes a brief demonstration, details of our research around staff ‘agency’ and case study information on how to embed SIAT in your school.

Date and Time

21st March, 5pm to 6pm

Venue

Online via zoom

Agenda

  • Catslyst - our evidence-informed approach to agency
  • How Catalyst works
  • Reporting and feedback
  • Embedding Catalyst in your school
  • N﻿ext Steps
